name: find_customer
title: Find customer
description: Find a customer in the customer master by name, optionally by city. Returns code, city, type and status. Several customers have similar names: if more than one matches, ask which.

name.description: part of the customer's name, e.g. Annapurna

customers.description: customer_code, name, city, state, type, status

next_step.description: what to do next, when there is something to ask
